newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: One dead, five injured in Colombian bus blast.
newsitem.headline: One dead, five injured in Colombian bus blast.

text.p: One man died and five were injured when a hand grenade exploded on a bus in the Caribbean coastal resort of Cartagena on Tuesday, Colombian police said.
The blast ripped through the city bus when a man got on board to escape police after a failed bid to extort money from a shopkeeper, national police sources said.
The man died and three passengers were injured by flying shrapnel. Two police in the street nearby were also injured.
Authorities cordoned off the area and called in explosives experts to defuse another grenade found near the dead man's body.
Local media broadcast contradictory reports earlier in the day with television speaking of two dead in the explosion.
